title: Theory 1
learning_outcomes_intro: After successfully completing the module, students will be able to

items: have basic knowledge in HCI including cognition and perception, UCD and UCD Process.
have basic knowledge on computer hardware, concepts and history of computer science.
understand concepts in computer science like computer architecture, bits & bytes.
understand user-centred, psychological and HCI concepts.
apply user-centred design, UI design concepts.
analyse user interfaces for patterns and interaction concepts
design and create interactions and user interfaces.
evaluate user interfaces using heuristics and design principles.

individual_component_content.component: a) Computer Science and HCI Theory
items: Perception (Visual, auditive and haptic), including colours
User-centred design and user-centred design process
